name: Lazlo Lipko
description: A Ravnican criminal whom Liliana killed after using his corpse as a spy.

timeline.summary: Liliana enters, and Jace refuses to trust her after she betrayed him; she reveals she had a spy killed to find him.
timeline.quote: "Nothing you can say will make me trust you," he said. "Not after you betrayed me."
